# Flipclock

A flip clock webapp for a phone mounted in a holder on a desk: looked at, never
operated. SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5 in forced runes mode, TypeScript, zero runtime
dependencies, Node 22 LTS. Local first: no backend, no API, no tracking, no CDN
font, and no network at all after the first load. At rest the screen shows only
the clock on black. A tap toggles fullscreen, a long press of about 600 ms opens
a settings overlay that dismisses itself. There is no visible control.

## Source files

- src/routes/+page.svelte: the clock itself. Composes the cards, runs the tick,
  wake lock, OLED pixel shift, theme attribute, tap and long press handling, and
  the one time hint. Sets --row-units on .row, which is what sizes the plates.
- src/routes/+layout.svelte: shell. Imports app.css, links icon and manifest.
- src/routes/+layout.ts: prerender = true and ssr = false, so the build is a
  static shell despite adapter-node.
- src/lib/clock.ts: time reading, formatting, and the drift free tick that
  recomputes the delay to the next boundary from Date on every step.
- src/lib/settings.svelte.ts: localStorage persistence, versioned migration
  chain, and the reactive settings singleton built on $state getters.
- src/lib/wakelock.ts: screen wake lock with re acquire on visibilitychange.
- src/lib/FlipCard.svelte: one two digit card, four layers, CSS keyframes.
  Honors prefers-reduced-motion by jumping instead of flipping.
- src/lib/SettingsOverlay.svelte: the long press overlay. Focus trap, Escape to
  close, auto dismiss after idle, closes on an outside tap.
- src/service-worker.ts: caches [...build, ...files] plus the prerendered shell.
  Cache first for assets, network with cache fallback otherwise. No skipWaiting.
- src/app.css: size token inputs, theme presets via [data-theme], aspect ratio
  media queries, sr-only, the bundled @font-face and the metric matched fallback
  that keeps the plate geometry if that file never loads.
- static/split-flap.woff2: the plate face, digits and colon only, 1.3 KB. Built
  by tools/build-font.py, which is not part of npm run build.
- src/lib/clock.test.ts, src/lib/settings.test.ts: vitest, pure logic only.

## Settings

localStorage key: flip-clock-settings. One JSON object with a version integer.
Keys: use24h (boolean), showSeconds (boolean), showDate (boolean), theme
('default' | 'warm' | 'night' | 'slate'), brightness (number, 0.2 to 1).
The list is closed. No timers, alarms, weather, calendar, music, accounts, sync
or color pickers.

The object also carries hintSeen (boolean), which is not a setting and is not in
the overlay. It records whether the one time "hold to customise" line has been
shown, so a first run points at the long press once and never again.
